name: Shinka no Yachou
source:
Along with the rise of the Fujiwara red light district,
a certain prostitute rose up the ranks as well.

Tsuguharu Kuse was born into a high-class family,
but one day is brought along to Fujiwara to witness this incredible man for himself...
As their destinies become intertwined, what will await them? Heaven or hell?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE271572.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
随着桃源花街兴起，
一位男花魁也声名鹊起。

久世嗣春出身名门，
某天，他受人带领，来到桃源，得以亲眼见到这位非凡的男子……
当两人的命运交织，他们走向的究竟会是极乐，还是地狱？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE271572.html]DLsite English[/url]]
